newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Davids to announce writedowns, sales - paper.
newsitem.headline: Davids to announce writedowns, sales - paper.

text.p: Grocery wholesaler and retailer Davids Ltd is expected to announce senior management changes, the sale of some non-retail assets and possible asset writedowns on Wednesday, The Australian Financial Review newspaper said.
"The announcement will come amid intense speculation about the future of Davids managing director Jeff David," the Financial Review said.

"It is also claimed Davids was preparing to write-off a significant portion of goodwill, which now stands at A$264 million, and drastically revalue major assets such as Campbells Cash and Carry, Jewel and QIW," the newspaper said.
The newspaper report did not include any sourcing and said neither Jeff David or executive chairman John David could be contacted on Tuesday.
Davids' shares closed unchanged at A$1.11 on Tuesday.
